contract: Native Android PdfDocument writer with host Canvas draw callback and measured View/Compose-host adapter. Source A4 595.2x841.8 rounds to integer595x842points; USLetter612x792. Require1..1000pages andpositive dimensions<=14400. Private uniquely named cache exports never overwrite a preexisting file; failed new output is deleted and document/page always finish/close. createFromViews requires main thread and measured views; caller owns thread for native Canvas drawing. Source50mock transactions/8perpage yields7pages; original Account label displaying amount is retained as an explicit sample quirk,not real financial data. Apple system glyph replaced with document mark; customhostcan draw actual branding. App gallery shares with narrow nonexported FileProvider grant or saves through user-selected Storage Access Framework; library leaves destination/provider setup to host. Host tests verify page layout ONLY: Robolectric has no native PdfDocument implementation. Real PDF bytes,renderer,share/SAF and Compose hardware/effect capture require actual Android test. Instrumentation test prepared separately; not executed. Source typography,glyphs and physical/iOS comparison unverified.
